title: A toggle hides the column's header and cells together; Customer, Subtotal and the chevron column are never in the list
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the report with data and the column selector open.
steps: 1. Turn the "Shop Supplies" toggle off, then on again, watching the table.
2. Read the toggle list for Customer, Subtotal, or a chevron entry.
expected: 1. Turning a toggle off hides that column's header and all its body cells together; turning it on restores both together.
2. The Customer and Subtotal columns and the chevron control column do NOT appear in the toggle list and are always present.
